answer: An attacker therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The grove counter is kept in nebula and trellis shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1375 identities would post 4981 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
